acceptanceCriteria: The legacy .corvint/index directory is removed (or reported as reclaimable with its size) by a supported index operation, with each removed file named in the receipt.
A test seeds a legacy directory and proves it is handled without touching the shared store.
body:
Observed 2026-10-07 by a read-only cleanup audit of the orchestrator session (code at batch 4 head 5808c26c; installed corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202). Owner goal: keep Corvint lean and efficient on disk and CPU.

Confirmed. /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint/.corvint/index holds 303 MiB (5 files, 2026-09-21..22) and ~/.codex/worktrees/corvint-v060-integration/corvint/.corvint/index holds 63 MiB. Snapshot eviction (IDX-SNAP-V0-025) runs only on the store being written (internal/contextindex/snapshot.go:205); the old per-worktree directory is never written again, so nothing evicts it.

Reproduce: du -sh .corvint/index in the primary checkout.
Expected: the next index write removes or migrates the legacy directory within the same bounds, or `index` reports it as reclaimable.
Actual: kept forever.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#649 (rc3 cleanup), merged to main 2026-10-07T13:49:36Z as ce6313a015bf94d1dc675eb2130b2c2c3851c65a. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-legacy-index-store-sweep.md, docs/decisions/0440-rc3-cleanup-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md and the sealed CEM .corvint/changes/48c959dbb62e0cc79ed4c81cc90a524920827e0f.cem.json at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; decision 0440 records the owner's acceptance of IDX-SNAP-V0-027. The batch passed focused package tests, go vet on darwin/linux/windows, the doc gates, dogfood check and seal, and every hosted CI check on the merge head. NOT_RUN: make gate, the live macOS update lifecycle, Linux dispatcher runtime and live dispatcher qualification. Native complete is refused with STALE_TREE (V1-0557), hence manual completion.

title: Legacy per-worktree .corvint/index snapshots are never removed after the move to the shared .git/corvint/index store
